title: Multi-agent AI systems are taking over supply chain execution
summary: Multi-agent AI systems are transforming supply chain execution by replacing traditional human approval workflows with autonomous agents that can make decisions across operational boundaries in real-time, moving beyond static dashboards and predictive models that still require human intervention.
problem_solved: Eliminates human bottlenecks in supply chain decision-making by enabling autonomous execution instead of waiting for scheduled human approval cycles.
why_valuable: Enables real-time, continuous supply chain optimization without human intervention delays, significantly improving operational responsiveness and efficiency.
